FIELDS.NAME: Hobby Haven
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Hobby Haven is a retail store specializing in a wide range of hobby and model-building supplies, including model kits, paints, tools, and accessories for both beginners and advanced enthusiasts. Our operations focus on providing a welcoming environment for hobbyists to explore their interests, with knowledgeable staff on hand to offer expert advice and assistance. We also host various instructional classes and workshops designed to enhance skills and foster community engagement, all covered by appropriate professional liability insurance. Our commitment to safety means we adhere strictly to local fire and safety codes, and we maintain a clean and organized store that ensures customer safety while enhancing the shopping experience. Regular inventory audits help us manage stock effectively, minimizing loss and ensuring availability of popular items. At Hobby Haven, we pride ourselves on offering quality products and a supportive atmosphere for creative expression in the hobby and model-building community.
FIELDS.OTHER BUSINESSES OWNED: Hobby Craft Co. - Online retail store for craft supplies and materials.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: Losses Occurred: Theft of inventory on 07/15/2022, valued at $1,000.00. Cause: Unsecured entrance during business hours. Status: Resolved with local law enforcement; new security measures implemented. Additionally, minor water damage from a leaky roof on 09/10/2022, resulting in $500.00 in repairs. Status: Completed repair works, roof maintenance scheduled.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday-Friday: 9:00 AM - 6:00 PM, Saturday: 10:00 AM - 5:00 PM, Sunday: Closed
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class 2, Grade B, UL Listed Safe for cash and valuables storage.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Security personnel present during business hours for theft deterrence and customer safety.

FIELDS.G2: Are athletic teams sponsored?: No – Hobby Haven does not sponsor any athletic teams. The focus of the business is solely on retailing hobby and model-building supplies and conducting related instructional classes.
FIELDS.G3: Are sub-contractors allowed to work: No – Sub-contractors are not allowed to work without providing a certificate of insurance. The certificates are typically checked by the management or designated staff responsible for compliance and risk management.
FIELDS.G4: Has any applicant been indicted or c: No – There have been no indictments or convictions for fraud, bribery, arson, or any related crimes in connection with this or any other property associated with the applicant.
FIELDS.G5: Any policy or coverage declined, can: No – There have been no policies or coverage declined, canceled, or non-renewed during the prior 3 years for Hobby Haven. The business maintains a good insurance record.
FIELDS.G6: Do you lease employees to or from ot: No – Hobby Haven does not lease employees to or from other employers, as all staffing is managed internally.
FIELDS.G7: Any Workers Compensation carried?: Yes – Hobby Haven carries Workers’ Compensation insurance as required for its employees, ensuring compliance and coverage for any potential workplace injuries.
FIELDS.G8: Do you own or operate any other busi: Yes – Hobby Haven also operates another business called Hobby Craft Co., which is an online retail store for craft supplies and materials.
FIELDS.G9: Any other insurance with this compan: No – Hobby Haven does not have any other insurance policies with this company aside from the current one indicated. The business maintains a streamlined approach to its insurance coverage.
FIELDS.G10: Are you involved in manufacturing,: No – Hobby Haven is not involved in manufacturing, mixing, relabeling, or repackaging of products beyond retail sales of hobby supplies. Our focus is solely on providing a variety of hobby and model-building materials to consumers.
FIELDS.G11: Do you rent or loan equipment to ot: No – Hobby Haven does not rent or loan equipment to others, as our operations focus primarily on retail sales of hobby and model-building supplies. We prioritize maintaining a controlled environment and ensuring the safety of our customers and products.
FIELDS.G12: Has applicant had a foreclosure, re: No – Hobby Haven has not experienced any foreclosure, repossession, bankruptcy, judgment, or lien during the past five years. The business maintains a stable financial position.
FIELDS.G13: Any exposure to flammables, explosi: No – Hobby Haven does not have any exposure to flammables, explosives, or hazardous chemicals as our operations focus on retailing hobby supplies in a safe and compliant environment.
FIELDS.G14: Any catastrophe exposure?: No – Hobby Haven does not have any catastrophe exposure as it primarily operates in a retail environment without engaging in high-risk activities or handling hazardous materials. The store adheres to all safety regulations, minimizing potential risks.
FIELDS.G15: Any past losses or claims relating: No – Hobby Haven has not had any past losses or claims relating to sexual abuse or molestation allegations, discrimination, or negligent hiring. The business maintains a strong commitment to ethical practices and employee training.
FIELDS.G16: Any uncorrected fire code violation: No – Hobby Haven does not have any uncorrected fire code violations, as the business strictly adheres to all local fire and safety codes and maintains a safe environment for customers and staff.
